description: Curated Secure Score action -> registry check overrides (T-0603, EPIC-031 SPEC §11.1). Applied only where the registry derivation cannot resolve an action id, or to correct an ambiguous derivation. `check` is the module registry check id; `standardKey` is the framework the action is reported against. An entry with no `check` is a portal standard reference only.

overrides.note: Microsoft's MFA registration improvement action; the registry carries no Secure Score control id for it.
Portal standard reference only; no automated registry check exists for this action.
